auth.description:
To get your Wistia API access token:
1. Log in to your Wistia account.
2. Go to **Account Settings > API Access** (or visit https://my.wistia.com/account/api).
3. Click **Create Token** and give it a name.
4. Grant it the permissions you need (read/update/delete) and copy the token — it is only shown once.
5. Paste the token below.

create_project.name: create_project
create_project.description: Create a new project in your Wistia account.

name.description: The name of the new project.

adminEmail.description: The email of the user who will own the project. Defaults to the owner of the API token if left empty.

anonymousCanUpload.description: Allow anonymous (logged-out) users to upload media to this project.

anonymousCanDownload.description: Allow anonymous (logged-out) users to download media from this project.

public.description: Make the project accessible to anyone with the public link.

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new Wistia project to hold media, with an optional admin owner email and anonymous-upload/download and public-link visibility flags. Use when an agent needs a new container before adding media. Not idempotent: each call creates a separate project even with the same name.

update_project.name: update_project
update_project.description: Update the attributes of an existing project.

name.description: A new name for the project. Leave empty to keep the current name.

anonymousCanUpload.description: Allow anonymous (logged-out) users to upload media to this project.

anonymousCanDownload.description: Allow anonymous (logged-out) users to download media from this project.

public.description: Make the project accessible to anyone with the public link.

aiMetadata.description: Updates an existing Wistia project (referenced by its id) — its name and its anonymous-upload/download and public-link visibility flags; omitted fields are left unchanged. Use to rename or change the sharing settings of a known project. Idempotent: repeating with the same values leaves the project in the same state.

get_media.name: get_media
get_media.description: Retrieve the details of a single video or media file.

mediaId.description: The video or media file to use.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves the full details of a single Wistia media item by its hashed media id. Use when an agent already has a specific media id and needs its current attributes. Read-only and idempotent.

find_media.name: find_media
find_media.description: Search and list media in your account, optionally filtered by project, name, or type.

projectId.description: Only return media that belong to this project.

name.description: Only return media whose name exactly matches this value.

type.description: Only return media of this type.

limit.description: Maximum number of media to return (up to 100).

aiMetadata.description: Lists media in the account, returning the most recent first up to the limit. With no filters set it fetches recent media broadly; supplying a project, an exact name match, or a media type narrows the results. Use to discover media or resolve a name to a hashed media id. Read-only and idempotent.

update_media.name: update_media
update_media.description: Update the name or description of a video or media file.

mediaId.description: The video or media file to use.

name.description: A new name for the media. Leave empty to keep the current name.

description.description: A new description shown next to the media in Wistia. Plain text or Markdown is supported.

aiMetadata.description: Updates the name and/or description of an existing Wistia media item identified by its hashed media id; omitted fields are left unchanged. Use to rename or re-describe a known media. Idempotent: repeating with the same values leaves the media in the same state.

copy_media.name: copy_media
copy_media.description: Create a copy of a video or media file, optionally into a different project.

mediaId.description: The video or media file to use.

owner.description: The email of the user who will own the copy. Defaults to the owner of the original media if left empty.

aiMetadata.description: Duplicates an existing Wistia media item (referenced by its hashed media id), optionally placing the copy in a target project and assigning a new owner by email. Use to clone a video or asset rather than re-uploading. Not idempotent: each call produces a new, distinct copy.

delete_media.name: delete_media
delete_media.description: Permanently delete a video or media file from your account.

mediaId.description: The video or media file to use.

aiMetadata.description: Permanently removes a Wistia media item identified by its hashed media id. Use only when the media should be irreversibly deleted; this cannot be undone. Not idempotent in effect: the first call deletes the media and subsequent calls target a media that no longer exists.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

de.Video hosting and analytics for business: Video Hosting und Analyse für Unternehmen. Verwalten Sie Ihre Projekte und Medienbibliothek.
Um Ihr Wistia API Zugangs-Token zu erhalten:
1. Melden Sie sich bei Ihrem Wistia Konto an.
2. Gehen Sie zu **Kontoeinstellungen > API Access** (oder besuchen Sie https://my.wistia.com/account/api).
3. Klicke **Erstelle Token** und gebe ihm einen Namen.
4. Erteilen Sie ihm die Berechtigungen, die Sie benötigen (lesen/aktualisieren/löschen) und kopieren Sie den Token — er wird nur einmal angezeigt.
5. Fügen Sie den Token unten ein.

fr.Video hosting and analytics for business: Hébergement de vidéos et analyses pour les entreprises. Gérez vos projets et votre médiathèque.
Pour obtenir votre jeton d'accès à l'API Wistia :
1. Connectez-vous à votre compte Wistia.
2. Allez dans **Paramètres du compte > Accès de l'API** (ou visitez https://my.wistia.com/account/api).
Cliquez sur **Créer un jeton** et donnez-lui un nom.
4. Accorder les permissions dont vous avez besoin (lecture/mise à jour/suppression) et copier le jeton — il n'est affiché qu'une seule fois.
5. Collez le jeton ci-dessous.

fr.Permanently delete a video or media file: Supprimer définitivement un fichier vidéo ou multimédia de votre compte.
fr.Make a custom API call to a specific end: Passer un appel API personnalisé à un endpoint spécifique

fr.Allow anonymous (logged-out) users to up: Autoriser les utilisateurs anonymes (déconnectés) à télécharger des médias vers ce projet.
fr.Allow anonymous (logged-out) users to do: Autoriser les utilisateurs anonymes (déconnectés) à télécharger des médias à partir de ce projet.
fr.Make the project accessible to anyone wi: Rendre le projet accessible à tous ceux qui ont le lien public.

es.Video hosting and analytics for business: Alojamiento de vídeo y análisis para negocios. Administra tus proyectos y la biblioteca de medios.
Para obtener tu token de acceso a Wistia API:
1. Inicia sesión en tu cuenta de Wistia.
2. Ve a **Configuración de Cuenta > Acceso API** (o visita https://my.wistia.com/account/api).
3. Haz clic en **Crear ficha** y dale un nombre.
4. Conceda los permisos que necesita (leer/actualizar/eliminar) y copie el token — sólo se muestra una vez.
5. Pega el token a continuación.

es.Permanently delete a video or media file: Elimina permanentemente un archivo de vídeo o multimedia de tu cuenta.

pt.Video hosting and analytics for business: Hospedagem de vídeo e análise para negócios. Gerencie seus projetos e biblioteca de mídia.
Para obter o seu token de acesso à API do Wisti:
1. Faça o login na sua conta do Wistia.
2. Vá para **Configurações da Conta > Acesso à API** (ou visite https://my.wistia.com/account/api).
3. Clique em **Criar Token** e dê um nome a ele.
4. Conceda as permissões que você precisa (ler/atualizar/excluir) e copie o token — ele só é exibido uma vez.
5. Cole o token abaixo.
